question: Living in groups
solution: Humans are gregarious animals who like to live in societies. झुंड में रहने वाले या मिलनसार स्वभाव के जीव/व्यक्ति।

question: One who is easily deceived
solution: He is so gullible that he believed the scammer's story. वह व्यक्ति जिसे आसानी से मूर्ख बनाया या ठगा जा सके।

question: The scientific study of old age and its problems
solution: Gerontology focuses on the social and biological aspects of aging. वृद्धावस्था और उम्र बढ़ने की प्रक्रिया का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन।

question: The branch of medicine dealing with the problems of the old
solution: Geriatrics is becoming more important as the average life expectancy increases. वृद्ध लोगों की बीमारियों और समस्याओं का चिकित्सा शास्त्र।

question: A person with exceptional intellectual or creative ability
solution: Albert Einstein was a scientific genius. वह व्यक्ति जिसकी बुद्धि या रचनात्मकता असाधारण हो (प्रतिभाशाली)।

question: The science of heredity
solution: Genetics explains why children often look like their parents. वंशानुक्रम या आनुवंशिकी का विज्ञान।

question: To run or jump about playfully
solution: The lambs were gambolling in the green fields. खुशी और खेल-कूद में उछलकूद करना।

question: A chief or commander of an army
solution: The General led his troops into the battle with courage. सेना का सबसे ऊँचा कमांडर या सेनाध्यक्ष।

question: Inflammation of the gums
solution: Regular flossing can help prevent gingivitis. मसूड़ों में होने वाली सूजन या दर्द की स्थिति।

question: A pair of lenses set in a frame to correct vision
solution: He needs glasses to read the small print. आँखों की दृष्टि सुधारने वाला चश्मा।

question: A piece of living tissue transplanted surgically
solution: The surgeon performed a skin graft on the patient. जीवित ऊतक का एक शरीर से दूसरे में प्रत्यारोपण।

question: The study of handwriting to analyse personality
solution: Graphology is often used by human resource departments during hiring. हस्तलेख का अध्ययन करने वाला विज्ञान।

question: To look at someone in an angry or threatening way
solution: The two boxers glowered at each other before the fight. किसी की तरफ गुस्से में घूर कर देखना।

question: Causing annoyance or resentment
solution: It was a galling experience to lose the match in the final minute. जो स्थिति बहुत कष्टदायक (annoying) या अपमानजनक महसूस हो।

question: An act or remark that is calculated to gain an advantage
solution: His opening gambit in the negotiation was very clever. ऐसी कोई चाल या बात जो फायदा पाने के लिए सोची-समझी हो।

question: A glass building used for growing plants
solution: We grow tomatoes in our greenhouse during winter. पौधों को ठंड से बचाने के लिए बनाया गया शीशे का घर।

question: A person who studies the Earth and its materials
solution: Geologists study rocks to understand the history of our planet. पृथ्वी की बनावट का अध्ययन करने वाला भूवैज्ञानिक।

question: Without payment
solution: The legal advice was given to the poor gratis. जो चीज़ बिना किसी शुल्क या पैसे के मिले (निःशुल्क)।

question: A doctor who specialises in women's reproductive system
solution: Women should visit a gynaecologist for regular health checkups. महिला रोगों और उनके प्रजनन तंत्र की विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर।

question: A poor area of a city where a particular race or religion lives
solution: In some historical periods, minority groups were forced to live in ghettos. शहर का वह पिछड़ा हिस्सा या बस्ती जहाँ कोई खास समुदाय रहता हो।

question: A movement of the body to express an idea or feeling
solution: A thumbs-up is a universal gesture of approval. शरीर के किसी अंग (जैसे हाथ) द्वारा किया गया इशारा।

question: The scientific study of the Earth’s structure and rocks
solution: Geology helps in finding minerals and oil underground. पृथ्वी की आंतरिक संरचना और चट्टानों का विज्ञान (भूगर्भशास्त्र)।

question: A connoisseur of good food and cooking
solution: A gourmet appreciates high-quality ingredients and fine cooking. स्वादिष्ट और अच्छे भोजन का पारखी जानकार।

question: Unintelligible or meaningless speech or writing
solution: He was talking gibberish because of the fever. ऐसी भाषा या शब्द जिनका कोई अर्थ न निकले (बेमतलब)।

question: The art and practice of cooking and eating good food
solution: Paris is often considered the capital of world gastronomy. उत्तम भोजन बनाने और खाने की कला (पाक कला)।

question: A list of technical or special words with their meanings
solution: You can find definitions of difficult terms in the glossary at the back of the book. कठिन या तकनीकी शब्दों की व्याख्या वाली सूची।

question: A building where grain is stored
solution: The granary was full of wheat after the harvest. वह स्थान जहाँ अनाज इकट्ठा करके रखा जाता है (धान्यागार)।

question: A room filled with equipment for physical exercise
solution: I go to the gymnasium every morning to stay fit. कसरत या व्यायाम करने के लिए बना कमरा।

question: The origin or birth of a thing
solution: This book explores the genesis of the industrial revolution. किसी चीज़ की शुरुआत या उसकी उत्पत्ति।

question: A person who studies and works with gemstones
solution: A gemologist can tell if a diamond is real or fake. रत्नों या कीमती पत्थरों का विशेषज्ञ।

question: The deliberate killing of a large group of people
solution: The world must prevent genocide to protect humanity. किसी विशेष राष्ट्र या जातीय समूह का सामूहिक नरसंहार।

question: Causing horror or shock
solution: The victims had ghastly injuries after the accident. जो देखने में बहुत डरावना या भयावह (horror) हो।

question: One who eats excessively
solution: He is such a glutton that he finished the whole cake by himself. वह व्यक्ति जो बहुत अधिक भोजन करता है (पेटू)।

question: Something that truly comes from its stated source
solution: This is a genuine leather jacket, not a fake one. जो पूरी तरह से असली (authentic) हो।

question: Expressed in an unclear or confusing way
solution: The message was so garbled that I couldn't understand anything. वह बात या संदेश जो बहुत अस्पष्ट या उलझा हुआ (confusing) हो।

question: To manipulate electoral boundaries for political advantage
solution: To gerrymander is to change the size and borders of an area for voting so as to give an unfair advantage to one party. राजनीतिक लाभ पाने के लिए चुनावी क्षेत्रों की सीमाओं में चालाकी से फेरबदल करना।

question: To reduce to powder by crushing
solution: You need to grind the coffee beans before making coffee. किसी चीज़ को पीसकर पाउडर बनाना।

question: A strong blast of wind
solution: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off. हवा का एक तेज़ और अचानक आने वाला झोंका।

question: To eat or drink quickly and in large amounts
solution: He took a big gulp of water after the race. किसी चीज़ को जल्दी-जल्दी निगल जाना।

question: Writing or drawings made on walls without permission
solution: The subway walls were covered in colorful graffiti. सार्वजनिक दीवारों पर की गई चित्रकारी या लिखावट।

question: The shortest possible path between two points on a curved surface
solution: Pilots follow geodesic paths to save fuel during long flights. वक्र सतह पर दो बिंदुओं के बीच का सबसे छोटा मार्ग।

question: A belief that the Earth is the centre of the universe
solution: Ancient astronomers believed in geocentrism before the sun-centered model. वह सिद्धांत जो पृथ्वी को ब्रह्मांड का केंद्र मानता है।

question: A person who fits and repairs glass in windows
solution: We called a glazier to fix the broken window pane. वह कारीगर जो खिड़कियों में कांच लगाने का काम करता है।

question: The main point or essence of a speech or text
solution: I missed the meeting, but my friend gave me the gist of it. किसी बात या लेख का मुख्य सार या निचोड़।

question: An extreme fear of public speaking
solution: Glossophobia is a very common fear among students. लोगों के सामने खड़े होकर भाषण देने का अत्यधिक डर।

question: An extremely large mass of ice which moves very slowly
solution: Glaciers are melting rapidly due to global warming. बर्फ की विशाल नदी जो धीरे-धीरे पहाड़ों से नीचे खिसकती है।

question: Excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters
solution: My garrulous neighbor kept me talking for an hour about the weather. वह व्यक्ति जो बहुत ज़्यादा बातूनी हो, खासकर मामूली बातों पर।

question: A person who analyses handwriting to determine personality
solution: Graphologists believe your handwriting reveals your character. हस्तलेख (handwriting) का विश्लेषण करने वाला विशेषज्ञ।

question: Brave, noble, and chivalrous
solution: A gallant person shows great bravery and respect, especially towards women. जो व्यक्ति वीर, साहसी और शिष्ट (noble) हो।

question: A person who enjoys eating and often eats too much
solution: A gourmand is someone who takes great pleasure in consuming large amounts of food. अधिक खाने वाला भोजन-प्रेमी।

question: A low guttural sound made by a pig
solution: Pigs grunt when they are rooting for food. सूअर की घुरघुराहट वाली आवाज़।

question: A government by old people
solution: Gerontocracy refers to a state or society governed by old people. वृद्ध या बुजुर्ग लोगों द्वारा चलाया जाने वाला शासन।

question: The sound a bear makes
solution: We heard a low growl from the bushes. भालू या कुत्ते के गुर्राने की आवाज़।

question: The category to which a film or series belongs
solution: Sci-fi is my favorite movie genre. साहित्य, संगीत या फिल्मों की एक विशेष शैली या श्रेणी।

question: Elegance and smoothness of movement
solution: The dancer moved with such grace across the stage. चलने या हिलने-डुलने में दिखाई देने वाली शालीनता।

question: To bite like a rat
solution: Rats often gnaw through electrical wires. किसी चीज़ को दाँतों से कुतरना।

question: To talk a lot about unimportant things
solution: They spent the whole afternoon gabbing about fashion. बिना किसी काम के बेकार की गप्पें मारना या फालतू बातें करना।

question: To deceive or trick someone
solution: The con artist tried to gull the old lady out of her inheritance. किसी को झांसा देना या मूर्ख बनाकर धोखा देना।

question: Extremely large
solution: The blue whale is a gigantic sea creature. जो आकार में बहुत ही बड़ा या विशालकाय हो।

question: The act of speaking or writing in a pompous manner to impress others
solution: His grandiloquence during the speech made him sound very arrogant. दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए इस्तेमाल की गई भारी-भरकम या आडंबरपूर्ण भाषा।

question: An informal way of spreading information or rumours
solution: I heard it on the grapevine that the manager is resigning. बातचीत के ज़रिए अफ़वाहें फैलने का अनौपचारिक माध्यम।

question: An agent that destroys germs
solution: This liquid soap acts as a powerful germicide. वह पदार्थ जो कीटाणुओं (germs) को नष्ट करने का काम करता है।

question: A place where the remains of dead people are buried
solution: They laid flowers on the tomb in the graveyard. वह स्थान जहाँ मृतकों को दफनाया जाता है (कब्रिस्तान)।

question: Foolish talk or ideas
solution: Don't listen to him, it's all a lot of guff. ऐसी बातें या विचार जिनका कोई तर्क न हो (बकवास)।

question: Tiring and demanding
solution: Training for a marathon is a gruelling process. कोई ऐसा कार्य जो बहुत ही थका देने वाला और कठिन हो।

question: Willing to give more than usual or expected
solution: It was very generous of you to pay for my dinner. वह व्यक्ति जो दूसरों की मदद के लिए बड़ा दिल रखता हो (उदार)।

question: To engage in casual conversation or rumors about others
solution: It's common for neighbors to gossip over tea. दूसरों के बारे में इधर-उधर की बातें या अफवाहें फैलाना।

question: A small growth of trees without underbrush
solution: We had a picnic in the olive grove. छोटे पेड़ों का समूह या उपवन।

question: A loud and boisterous laugh
solution: His jokes always caused a loud guffaw from the audience. खिलखिलाकर हँसना या बहुत ज़ोरदार हँसी।

question: To speak quickly in a way that cannot be understood
solution: He was gibbering with fear after seeing the shadow. हड़बड़ाहट या डर के मारे जल्दी-जल्दी कुछ ऐसा बोलना जो समझ न आए।

question: An artful or simulated semblance
solution: He visited the village in the guise of a commoner. किसी की पहचान छिपाने के लिए बनाया गया वेश या बाहरी दिखावा।

question: A person who travels widely around the world
solution: As a globetrotter, she has visited over fifty countries. वह व्यक्ति जो पूरी दुनिया में बहुत ज़्यादा यात्रा करता है।

question: Rough and low in pitch
solution: He answered the phone in a gruff voice, as if he had just woken up. ऐसी आवाज़ जो सुनने में रूखी या कर्कश (rough) लगे।

question: A device used for strangling, typically a wire or cord
solution: A garrotte was used historically as a method of execution. तार या रस्सी जैसा उपकरण जिससे गला घोंटा जाता है।

question: Relating to or involving old people
solution: The hospital has a special geriatric ward for senior citizens. बुढ़ापे या वृद्ध व्यक्तियों के स्वास्थ्य और देखभाल से संबंधित।
